_comment: The whole-attempt deadline. Each case runs one keyless search (max_retries 0, the case's timeout in seconds; TypeScript's timeoutMs is this times 1000, Go's Duration this times one second) against a raw HTTP/1.1 server on 127.0.0.1 that answers every request the same way, in one of four phases. headers: the status line, then one byte of a header value every `interval` seconds, `pieces` times, then the rest of the headers and the body. body: the headers at once (Content-Length set), then one space of the body every `interval` seconds, `pieces` times, then the JSON. terminator: chunked headers at once, the one data chunk (the whole JSON) after `interval` seconds, and the terminating zero-length chunk after `interval` seconds more (pieces is 1). Each gap is shorter than the timeout, so only a deadline on the whole attempt catches it. none: the whole reply at once. The JSON is {"results": []}. outcome timeout: the SDK's timeout error, raised no earlier than timeout - 0.05 s and no later than timeout + slack. outcome success: a result with no results, sooner than the timeout.

cases.name: body trickled but finished within the timeout
